message.content:
**Uno – Game Rules (Simplified)** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points over multiple rounds. | | **Setup** | • 108-card deck (0‑9, Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild, Wild Draw Four).
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place remaining cards face down as draw pile; flip top card to start discard pile. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise unless a Reverse changes direction. | | **Playing a Card** | • Match color or number of top discard.
• Or play a special card (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild, Wild Draw Four). | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two and skips turn.
• **Wild** – choose new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – choose new color; next player draws four and skips turn (must be played only if you have no matching color). | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play, draw one card from draw pile. If it’s playable, you may immediately play it. | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you’re left with one card, shout “UNO!” before your next opponent plays. | | **Penalty for Forgetting UNO** | If caught before the next player takes a turn, you must draw two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | First player to reach 500 points wins the game. Points are tallied from opponents’ remaining cards: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Optional Variations** | • **Stacking** – allow players to stack Draw Twos or Wild Draw Fours.
• **Custom Decks** – use themed decks or add extra special cards. | That’s the core gameplay! Feel free to tweak or add house rules for extra fun.
